title: Chiller power with two overlapping predictors
intro: The electric power of a building's chiller (kW) on 15 summer afternoons, with the cooling load (tons), the chilled-water flow (L/s) and the outdoor wet-bulb temperature (°C). The flow is set by the control system almost in proportion to the load, so the two predictors carry nearly the same information. The model explains 99 % of the variation, yet the flow's coefficient has p = 0.54, and the variance inflation factors of load and flow are both above 100: multicollinearity.
